purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for a Sa'auei'a child's burden-flower grooming contract.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for the breeding-ground arrival terrace, the grooming kit and body affordances, the alarm bloom, the witnessed comparison, the departure choice, and four ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the terrace establishing view, grooming closeup, ordinary routine fold, pivotal alarm bloom, public alarm reading, comparison fold, departure threshold, and each ending family. The one-sentence red bloom stands alone in replay.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt stands alone for a general image model, explains fictional organisms and environments as visible forms, and names only bodies visible in the frame. Continuity notes remain tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: intimate ecological science-fantasy storybook illustration, restrained ink contours and layered watercolor texture, dark mineral stone, muted blue-green organisms, amber fungal lights, dim red-sun illumination, expressive nonhuman body language, precise natural-history detail, gentle domestic wit, cinematic framing suitable for interactive fiction.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each image prompt from the global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for visible characters or groups, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Exclude absent refs and continuity-note prose. Each generation begins from the complete assembled text and a camera-specific scene-set input when one exists.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture remains on one arrival terrace but returns to it from wide, close, routeward, and ending angles; the embedded coordinate map fixes the fungal boundary, grooming mat, bowls, nursery ramps, lantern trees, pack line, cameras, staging slots, and sightlines.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: A simple 3D blockout may replace the embedded layout if the fixture is promoted to high-consistency multi-angle animation; the structured 2D layout is the current geometry authority for illustrated replay.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view of an outdoor Sa'auei'a breeding-ground arrival terrace built from dark root-bound stone in a broad fan shape. The narrow routeward throat is crossed by two rows of ankle-high amber fungal fruiting candles; the broad nurseryward edge descends along three shallow ramps into warm communal hollows. Low lantern trees line the inner rim with blue-white glowing knots beneath their branches. On the outer rim, a long-bodied six-limbed child rests on four folded digitigrade running legs beside a rectangular reed grooming mat while two smaller three-digit chest limbs hover over two shallow stone bowls, three soft-pronged combs, and a packet of mineral salts. A small mobile blue-gray plant with clasping rootlets and flat leaves grips a bare patch on the child's left flank. An older long-bodied cousin settles across the mat. A huge fixed dark planet covers most of the dim red sun, leaving a returning crescent of light.

visible_characters.default_stance: four running legs folded beside the outer-rim grooming mat, chest hands poised above the bowls
folded across the mat with facial fans open toward the flower and road
attached to the child's bare left flank with leaves angled toward returning light

visual_continuity_notes: The terrace stays fan-shaped: fungal-road boundary at the narrow routeward throat, three nursery ramps at the broad edge, lantern trees on the inner rim, grooming mat on the outer rim, and family packs just beyond the mat toward the road.
Sa'auei'a bodies remain long-bodied hexapods with four tall digitigrade locomotor legs, two smaller chest manipulators, wedge heads, paired facial scent-fans, dark hide, and short insulating fibers.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Close-medium natural-history view at the outer rim of a dark stone terrace. On the child's bare left flank, a hand-sized mobile plant holds with pale rootlets; several flat blue-gray photosynthetic leaves surround a cup of fine sensory filaments. An older Sa'auei'a cousin watches from across the mat, facial fans spread toward the bowls. Amber fungal candles and blue-white lantern knots glow softly in the background under eclipse dimness.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide routeward threshold view of the fan-shaped breeding-ground terrace in returning light. The reed grooming mat lies on the outer rim with two shallow bowls, combs, a salt packet holding a narrow pruning blade in its outer seam, and a knotted route cord. The child begins to rise on four digitigrade running legs while two small chest hands hover between a hand-sized mobile plant with pale rootlets, blue-gray leaves, and a silver sensory cup; the catch bowl; a clean outer pack strap; and the blade packet. The elder cousin waits across the mat. Balanced family packs line the routeward side. Amber fungal candles cross the narrow terrace throat; three shallow nursery ramps and blue-white lantern knots remain visible behind the pair. The composition presents four physical choices: make and offer a wash sample at the fungal verge, turn the mat into sunlight, transfer the flower visibly to the pack strap, or reach for the blade.

visual_character_refs.purpose: Stable visual identities for prompt assembly. Include only refs for bodies visible in a scene.

characters.saueia_route_child: Sa'auei'a route child: juvenile long-bodied hexapod about two-thirds adult length; four tall digitigrade running legs; two smaller chest limbs ending in three soft opposing digits; wedge-shaped head; paired flexible facial scent-fans; short charcoal-blue insulating fibers over dark plum hide; bare throat and left-flank signal patches; balanced moss-green woven flank packs when standing; quick curious posture expressed through neck angle, facial-fan spread, foot placement, and chest-hand precision.
characters.elder_cousin_grooming_witness: Older Sa'auei'a cousin: adult long-bodied hexapod with four sturdy digitigrade running legs, two small three-digit chest manipulators, wedge head, paired facial scent-fans, short rust-brown fibers over dark hide, one pale healed stripe across the right facial fan, faded ochre route wraps around the forward locomotor pair, patient low posture and dry watchfulness.
characters.childs_burden_flower: Child's burden flower: hand-sized mobile plant analogue with pale clasping rootlets, several flat blue-gray photosynthetic leaves, fine silver sensory filaments in a central cup, leaf veins able to display clear silver, yellow, violet, and red bands, dark beadlike seeds beneath the leaf bases; movement through slow release and regrip of rootlets.

groups.terrace_morning_caretakers: Terrace morning caretakers and infants: several long-bodied Sa'auei'a hexapods with four digitigrade running legs, two smaller chest manipulators, wedge heads, paired facial scent-fans, dark hides under short muted fibers, simple woven route wraps; adults work low beside nursery ramps while three small infants imitate lantern pulses with hand-sized covered lamps.
groups.departing_family_adults: Two departing adult Sa'auei'a: long-bodied hexapods standing on four tall digitigrade legs with two small chest limbs folded beneath the forward torso, paired facial scent-fans angled toward the flower, short dark fibers, balanced woven flank packs, patient but visibly delayed posture.
